Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese sesta feira (“Friday”), a learned borrowing from Ecclesiastical Latin sexta fēria (“Friday”, literally “sixth weekday”), from Latin fēria + sexta, literally “sixth weekday”. displaced earlier vernes. Compare Galician sexta feira (“Friday”), Mirandese sesta-feira (“Friday”), Asturian estaferia and Spanish sextaferia.
